name: No Expectation
source: You haven't seen your best friend for a couple of years because you took different paths in your life, now he is getting married and you're the best man. It's worth mentioning that you've always been in love with his sister, maybe this is your chance to do something about it... maybe. Nobody knows what could happen on a weekend. Right?
translation: 你已经好几年没见到你最好的朋友了，因为你们的人生道路不同，现在他要结婚了，你是伴郎。值得一提的是，你一直深爱着他的妹妹，也许这是你做点什么的机会……也许吧。没有人知道周末会发生什么。正确的？
